Beldum

Steel Psychic

Hoenn · Generation 3

Beldum is a Steel/Psychic-type Iron Ball Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 95.2 kg. It evolves into Metang. Its highest base stat is Defense (80), with a base stat total of 300.
